title: Dave Canales says defensive coaching changes are about the players feeling confident

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dave Canales says defensive coaching changes are about the players feeling confident
sources.description: Panthers head coach Dave Canales fired defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero and defensive passing game coordinator Jonathan Cooley less than 12 hours after Thursday night's loss to the Packers, and Canales said on Friday afternoon that he wants his players to be confident in their defense.
